tagline: A true piece of art, just by its design.
description: An adjustable low-glare luminaire with a wide choice of reflector colours. White or Silver suits workspaces and offices; Black or Gold adds an extra dimension to hotels and restaurants.
specification: Recessed adjustable downlight, tilt 25° | rotation 355°. L80 50000H B10. 3-step MacAdam. Remote power supply. 230Vac | 50/60Hz.

tagline: A deep-set downlight that all but disappears into the ceiling.
description: A compact fixed downlight with the light source set deep inside the reflector, so you see the light rather than the fitting. The narrow trim and Ø75mm cut-out keep the ceiling calm, making it a natural choice for hotel rooms, restaurants, lounges and homes, as general light or soft accent.
specification: Fixed recessed downlight with deep-set LED. Die-cast aluminium housing with a black or white reflector to match. Cut-out Ø75mm. CRI 90. 3-step MacAdam. Lifetime 50,000h. 220–240Vac | 50/60Hz. Class II. IP44. Replaceable LED and driver. 5-year warranty.
